psychological_meaning: Bouquet evokes feelings of romance, nostalgia, and gentle sophistication. It represents a delicate balance between strength and softness, suggesting a sense of understated elegance and quiet confidence. This color can inspire creativity, promote relaxation, and foster a sense of inner peace.
